2026-08-14 re-audit: found a third independent domain (thefisherman.com, 'Hot Spot: NJ Artificial Reef Sites') that explicitly confirms the finding from the 2026-06-18 pass — NJ's artificial reef program uses named sites only (17 named sites listed), with no numbered 'Site 15' designation. This specific finding now has 3-source support. However, the TRUE IDENTITY of the site at these exact coordinates (39.1917, -74.3583) remains UNRESOLVED — it sits between the Ocean City Reef (39°09.891'/-74°34.310') and Great Egg Reef (39°14.498'/-74°21.483') per fffnj.com coordinates, but does not cleanly match either. Description remains based on regional characteristics of both nearby reefs rather than a confirmed specific site. Recommend renaming/re-identifying this entry against the NJ DEP GIS reef dataset (gisdata-njdep.opendata.arcgis.com) in a future pass.

2026-08-14 re-audit CORRECTION: previous entry called the Carrabassett a '90-foot steel dragger' citing njscuba.net vs. an 'unresolved' 82-foot figure from nationalfisherman.com. Re-pulled nationalfisherman.com directly — it is the primary, most authoritative source (a maritime trade publication account of the vessel's actual final voyage) and confirms 82 feet; corrected length to 82 ft. Also discovered via the same re-pull that the njscuba.net-era Carrabassett info was outdated: the vessel now on the Axel Carlson Reef is a DIFFERENT/newer deployment than previously described — ex-F/V Cowboy, owned by Carlos Rafael ('the Codfather'), acquired by Blue Harvest Fisheries and renamed Carrabassett, lost to a welding-accident fire in Feb 2024, and deliberately sunk in April 2024 in 72 ft of water off Point Pleasant Beach by NJ reef program coordinator Peter Clarke, funded by the Manasquan River Marlin & Tuna Club and The Sportfishing Fund. Markdown updated accordingly. Veronica M facts (110 ft, ex-Captain Bill, built 1950 Jacobson Shipyards Oyster Bay NY, sunk Nov 10 2004, named for Veronica Segars) reconfirmed via direct re-fetch of gotosnapshot.com. Cunner remains excluded (no site-specific source).
